misprints.note: Väfveri: the article is printed τά, but in Väfkammare the same word takes τό.
No accent is printed on γε-νωμαι, which is split across a line break.
This is the printed form, which is correct. The old OCR had ἀποπίττεσθαι, and I fixed it to match the print.
The headword is printed with the letter d.

uncertain.note: The second letter is broken type, probably ω with a circumflex. The word continues ἀφορ- from 0518_02, which gives ἀφορμῶντι.
The breathing and accent on the first ι are squeezed together. I read smooth breathing with acute, but a circumflex (ἶσον) is possible.
The second c looks closed like an o (aco.). I wrote acc. as the book does elsewhere.
